goal: Let a person remove a project from the dashboard's Architecture list (sidebar and Projects page) and restore it, through new `harness board remove` / `restore` CLI commands that the dashboard calls.
constraints: Removal is reversible: it hides the project and stops background mapping, but keeps its stored board.
Mutations are POST forms checked against the session CSRF token.

non_goals.description: Do not delete board files or harness target registrations.
Leave the pre-existing arc upgrade and workbench edits in services/ as they are.

acceptance.criterion: board remove hides a project from list and stops mapping; restore brings it back
Dashboard remove and restore routes work end to end
